required_paths.heading: Path A — Normal supported accountless setup
required_paths.terminal: truthful Protection Map; core complete without login; optional account remains optional

required_paths.heading: Path B — Already configured
required_paths.terminal: duplicate work skipped without bypassing current verification or strengthening stored/account evidence

required_paths.heading: Path C — Unsupported / not covered
required_paths.terminal: Not covered/uncertain with explicit limitation and no speculative setup

required_paths.heading: Path D — Failed activation / verification failure
required_paths.terminal: evidence-backed correction, truthful unresolved state, or removal/recovery

required_paths.heading: Path E — False positive / legitimate content blocked
required_paths.terminal: narrow correction/recheck, unresolved help state, or removal without broad dashboard bypass control

required_paths.heading: Path F — Resume after interruption
required_paths.terminal: legitimate transient/account continuity only; no automatic J0/J1 promotion and stale status is reverified

required_paths.heading: Path G — Removal and recovery
required_paths.terminal: Removed with active protection claim withdrawn; account/device record lifecycle remains separate

required_paths.heading: Path H — Support / help
required_paths.terminal: state-neutral, source-current, self-service, privacy-minimal help across accountless/account paths

mandatory_invariants: full core journey remains usable without login
parent confirmation never becomes system verification
configuration/account/device record presence never directly establishes Verified
unsupported paths do not improvise setup
retries require a changed condition or safe idempotent operation
lost accountless state restarts without fabricated persistent history
account sign-in does not extend or automatically promote J0/J1
removal withdraws active UseSafeWeb DNS protection claim
dashboard/device record/account deletion is distinct from physical DNS removal
no browsing/query/activity history, child account, or raw DNS administration is introduced
EN/TR/AR RTL capability does not imply non-UK market activation
no pre-L8 human validation claim is made
